metadata.question: Did the Indus Basin aquifer region centered at coordinates 31.998723, 73.931617 (within a 10km radius) experience significant groundwater decline between 2003 and 2013?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use GRACE/GRACE-FO groundwater storage anomaly data. This is a global monthly product. We need images from 2003 (Jan 2003 baseline) and 2013 (Dec 2013) to get the trend over the decade. 2. Masking: Not required (aquifer grid, not optical/cloud data). 3. Location: Point (31.998723, 73.931617) buffered to ~10 km circle. 4. Logic: Compare mean storage anomaly (in cm of water equivalent) between early 2003 (3-month average Jan-Mar 2003) and late 2013 (Oct-Dec 2013). A negative difference (2013 < 2003) indicates decline; here “significant” is judged by a practical threshold of ≥5 cm decline (the product’s magnitude). No collection → C1 Valid pixels zero in either period → C2 Results are None/NaN → C3 Decline ≥ 5 cm → A, otherwise B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & time loc = ee.Geometry.Point(73.931617, 31.998723).buffer(10000) # 10 km radius grace = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LWE') start03 = ee.Date('2003-01-01') end03 = ee.Date('2003-04-01') start13 = ee.Date('2013-10-01') end13 = ee.Date('2014-01-01') # 2. Data availability check early = grace.filterDate(start03, end03) late = grace.filterDate(start13, end13) s1 = early.size().getInfo() s2 = late.size().getInfo() print(f"2003 images: {s1}, 2013 images: {s2}") if s1 == 0 or s2 == 0: print("C1") # 3. Earth observation variable def mean_anom(c): return c.select('lwe_thickness_csr').mean().multiply(0.1) # mm -> cm img03 = mean_anom(early) img13 = mean_anom(late) # 4. Compute & validate def mean_reg(im): obj = im.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=loc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) return obj.get('lwe_thickness_csr') v03 = ee.Number(mean_reg(img03)).getInfo() v13 = ee.Number(mean_reg(img13)).getInfo() if v03 is None or v13 is None: print("C3") cnt = img03.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=loc, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo() if cnt == 0: print("C2") delta = v13 - v03 print(f"Anom 2003: {v03:.1f} cm, 2013: {v13:.1f} cm, Δ: {delta:.1f} cm, pixels: {int(cnt)}") # 5. Answer print("A" if delta <= -5 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & time
loc = ee.Geometry.Point(73.931617, 31.998723).buffer(10000)  # 10 km radius
grace = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LWE')
start03 = ee.Date('2003-01-01')
end03   = ee.Date('2003-04-01')
start13 = ee.Date('2013-10-01')
end13   = ee.Date('2014-01-01')

# 2. Data availability check
early = grace.filterDate(start03, end03)
late  = grace.filterDate(start13, end13)
s1 = early.size().getInfo()
s2 = late.size().getInfo()
print(f"2003 images: {s1}, 2013 images: {s2}")
if s1 == 0 or s2 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Earth observation variable
def mean_anom(c):
    return c.select('lwe_thickness_csr').mean().multiply(0.1)  # mm -> cm
img03 = mean_anom(early)
img13 = mean_anom(late)

# 4. Compute & validate
def mean_reg(im):
    obj = im.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                         geometry=loc,
                         scale=1000,
                         maxPixels=1e9)
    return obj.get('lwe_thickness_csr')
v03 = ee.Number(mean_reg(img03)).getInfo()
v13 = ee.Number(mean_reg(img13)).getInfo()
if v03 is None or v13 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
cnt = img03.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                       geometry=loc,
                       scale=1000,
                       maxPixels=1e9).get('lwe_thickness_csr').getInfo()
if cnt == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
delta = v13 - v03
print(f"Anom 2003: {v03:.1f} cm, 2013: {v13:.1f} cm, Δ: {delta:.1f} cm, pixels: {int(cnt)}")

# 5. Answer
print("<answer>A</answer>" if delta <= -5 else "<answer>B</answer>")
